codeReview.summary: The billboard implementation is well-structured, correct, and follows existing codebase patterns. All 9 subtasks are properly implemented. The shader correctly extracts camera right/up from the view matrix, reads texture index from material_params.w, and samples from the bindless texture array. Draw call generation properly passes the bindless index via with_emission(), uses compute_gizmo_scale for constant screen-space sizing, and skips EditorHidden entities. All billboard code paths are correctly gated with #[cfg(feature = "editor")]. The icon rasterization uses skrifa+vello_cpu to generate white-on-transparent RGBA textures. BillboardComponents are attached to both PointLight and ParticleEmitter entities. Module structure and dependencies are correct.
